method: Reflected sunlight is modelled from SPHEREx's 0.7-2.6 um reflectance (flux divided by the ASTM E490 solar spectrum), extrapolated to 3.3-5 um and subtracted. The excess is fitted with the Near-Earth Asteroid Thermal Model (NEATM, Harris 1998) with a fixed beaming parameter (1.0 +- 0.2 beyond the near-Earth region, Masiero et al. 2011; 1.4 +- 0.5 for near-Earth objects, Mainzer et al. 2011) and emissivity 0.9; size and albedo are tied through D = 1329 km / sqrt(p_V) x 10^(-H/5). Uncertainties from 400 Monte Carlo draws over flux errors, orbit (or JPL geometry), H, G, beaming parameter and the extrapolation.
note: Compared over 44 object(s): sized by SPHEREx heat and with a diameter in JPL's Small-Body Database, out of 183 object(s) JPL identified.
